title: Senior UI Developer
jobDescription:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers. Role Summary Senior UI Engineer to build intelligent, scalable, and intuitive user interfaces for m IO, a cloud native telecom infrastructure orchestration platform. The role requires strong frontend engineering expertise, along with hands on experience in Kubernetes based platforms and AI assisted UI experiences, such as guided workflows, copilots, and intelligent recommendations Key Responsibilities Core Focus Areas AI‑Driven UI Experiences Design and implement AI‑assisted and guided user experiences (e.g., copilots, form assistants, smart defaults, recommendations) Integrate frontend with AI/ML-backed services (LLMs, rule engines, or recommendation APIs) Build UIs that support intent-based workflows, decision assistance, and automation Handle AI-related UX concerns: explainability, confidence indicators, error handling, and fallbacks Kubernetes & Cloud‑Native Platform Awareness Build UI features that visualize and manage Kubernetes / Open Shift resources Clusters, namespaces, workloads, pods, jobs, Helm releases, Argo CD apps Design dashboards for deployment status, health, logs, and lifecycle operations Work closely with backend and platform teams to represent complex infra concepts in a simple UI Understand multi-cluster, multi-tenant environments and reflect them correctly in the UI Job Requirements UI Development & Architecture Design and develop responsive, reusable, enterprise-scale UI components Own frontend architecture for dashboards, workflows, and operational views Translate UX designs and product requirements into high-quality, production-ready code Optimize UI performance for large datasets, real-time updates, and AI-driven flows Platform Integration Integrate UI with REST APIs / Graph QL and event-driven backend systems Implement authentication, authorization, RBAC, and tenant-aware UI behavior Work with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment models UX, Quality & Ownership Collaborate closely with UX designers to deliver clean, minimal, and intuitive user experiences Ensure accessibility, cross-browser compatibility, and responsiveness Write unit tests and component tests; maintain high UI quality standards Review code and mentor junior developers Mandatory Skills Frontend Engineering Strong experience in Angular (preferred) or React Expert in Type Script, Java Script (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 Solid knowledge of state management (Ng Rx / Redux / similar) Strong understanding of component-based and modular UI architecture Cloud‑Native & Kubernetes UI Hands-on experience building UIs for Kubernetes / Open Shift–based platforms Ability to work with infra-centric data: job status, logs, metrics, artifacts, deployments AI Integration Experience integrating UI with AI/ML or LLM-powered backends Understanding of AI UX patterns (assistants, suggestions, step-by-step guidance) Good to Have Experience with telecom platforms or large-scale enterprise systems Familiarity with micro-frontend architecture Experience with observability tools (logs, metrics, alerts) Exposure to AI governance, prompt tuning, or AI UX best practices Experience: 4
- 6 years Accessibility Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter. Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status. Role Summary We are looking for a highly capable Senior AI Engineer with 3–4 years of hands-on AI/ML experience to design, build, and productionize scalable AI systems across Generative AI, AI platforms, AI gateways, Voice AI, LLM fine-tuning, ML training, and ML pipelines. This role is for someone who can take ownership of complex AI initiatives end-to-end — from problem understanding, architecture, experimentation, model/pipeline development, deployment, observability, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across application engineering, ML engineering, LLM systems, APIs, infrastructure, and production-grade AI platform components Key Responsibilities Gen AI Application Engineering Design and build production-ready Gen AI applications using LLMs, SLMs, RAG, agents, tool-calling, workflow orchestration, and prompt engineering AI Gateway & AI Platform Engineering Contribute to the design and implementation of AI platform capabilities that enable safe, governed, and scalable use of AI models Voice AI Engineering Design and implement Voice AI systems involving speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speech translation, voice agents, and real-time conversational AI. LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Training Work on fine-tuning and training workflows for LLMs, SLMs, and task-specific ML models ML Pipelines & MLOps Design and maintain scalable ML pipelines for data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining Job Requirements Skills Required: Strong C, C++ and Python programming skills Hands-on Gen AI/LLM application development Understanding of ML training and evaluation workflows Ability to build APIs and backend services Understanding of scalable system design Experience with at least one ML/LLM framework Ability to work with data pipelines and model pipelines Fine-tuning frameworks such as PEFT, Lo RA, QLo RA, TRL, or Unslot Workflow orchestration using Airflow, Prefect, Kubeflow, Dagster, or similar tools Containerization using Docker Practical understanding of deployment, observability, and production readiness 3 to 4 years of hands-on experience in AI/ML, Gen AI, or ML engineering Strong practical exposure to building AI/ML systems, not just theoretical knowledge Accessibility Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities.
